$schema_notes: N27 deployment zones for Greater Boston food truck TAM. Each zone keys into one of: (a) a list of BPDA neighborhood names that must match data/neighborhoods.geojson exactly, or (b) a list of ZCTA5 codes that must match data/adjacent-zips.geojson. docs_only_subregions are named sub-areas referenced in the N27 prospectus that do not exist as distinct BPDA polygons — they roll up into the listed BPDA parents and are documented here for provenance only. Total truck_capacity across all active zones equals 50.

totals.docs_only_note: Financial District, Faneuil Hall, Seaport, Theatre District (in downtown_core) and Kendall Square, Cambridge Crossing (in innovation_corridor) are named in the N27 prospectus but are not separate BPDA polygons. They are listed as docs_only_subregions and roll up visually into their BPDA parents or adjacent zips at render time.
